metadata.summary: Executive Board of the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women - Second Regular Session 2026 (9 - 10 September 2026). The Executive Board governs the operational activities of UN-Women and provides operational policy guidance to the Entity.
metadata.description:
Structure dialogue on financing
Report on the structured dialogue on financing the results of the UN-Women Strategic Plan 2022-2025
categories: Subsidiary organs of the General Assembly
corporate_name: UNITED NATIONS ENTITY FOR GENDER EQUALITY AND THE EMPOWERMENT OF WOMEN - UN-WOMEN

sentences.text: Distinguished delegates, welcome back to the second regular session of the UN Women Executive Board.
Please take a seat.

Let us continue with agenda item 3 on structured dialogue on financing during which the Board will receive a presentation on the report on the structured dialogue on financing the results of the UN Women Strategic Plan 2022-2025 and future direction for the Strategic Plan 2026-2029.

In addition to the Executive Director, Deputy Executive Director and the Secretary, I am pleased to welcome to the podium the following UN Women colleagues: Mr. Kambu Fofana, OIC Deputy Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer and Director of the Division of Finance and Administration; Mrs. Sara Hendriks, Director of Policy, Program and Intergovernmental Division; Mrs. Anna-Karin Hjortfors, Director, Strategy, Planning, Results and Effectiveness Division; and Mrs. Megan Gilgun, Chief, Public Partnerships.

I am pleased to invite the Chief of Public Partnerships, Mrs. Megan Gilgan, to present the report on the structured dialogue on financing the results of the UN Women Strategic Plan 2022-2025 and future direction of the Strategic Plan 2026-2029.
I will open the floor for your comments and questions after her presentations.
as well as comments on the joint cost recovery report as needed.
Without further ado, please, Megan, you have the floor.
Thank you very much, Madam Chair.
Chair, Excellencies, distinguished delegates and colleagues, the presentation shared during the informal session provided a detailed overview of UN Women's financial position and funding outlook.
